en: The image shows a colored vintage postcard featuring a large, elegant building with multiple stories and numerous windows. The architectural style suggests early 20th-century European design. There are people in period clothing and a horse-drawn carriage in front of the building. The background shows a sloped dirt road and some trees. The text on the postcard is in two languages, referencing Varaždinske Toplice (Croatian) and Warasdin Töplitz (German), as well as Josipova kupelj (Josefi Bad), suggesting a spa or bathhouse.
